sourcePolicy.note: Use the RuneScape Wiki as canonical game-data ground truth unless a row was specifically sourced from PvME or RS Analysis; then keep and link that source for that row. Jagex reveal data remains provisional until the Wiki confirms it.

coverage.combat_system: partial-high; current core rules and major 2026 transitions captured, including the April Aura Overhaul replacement graph, with a current post-hotfix Magic/Ranged ability seed promoted through reference sync; exhaustive ability/item tables still pending
coverage.reference_research: PvME navigation and the public RS Analysis calculator/research surface have been harvested as deduplicated mechanic/dependency notes; source code, UI, boss-guide prose, rotations and settings-dependent calculator outputs are excluded
coverage.2026_changes: high; March combat modernisation, April aura replacement, May Dungeoneering remaster and July 20 rebalance now have current-data guards
coverage.catalyst: high-level progression complete; not every relic/task serialized yet
coverage.equilibrium: all currently captured public rules represented; unrevealed data tracked separately
coverage.regions: high-value content and upgrade chains mapped; hard, historical-working and unresolved external/cross-boundary cases are kept separate instead of forcing every location into a selectable region
coverage.region_boundaries: Daemonheim is a hard Forinthry rule; northern Asgarnia is consolidated; Fort/City of Um/Zanaris/Senntisten remain labelled historical working mappings; ED4/Zamorak is cross-boundary; The Arc/Wushanko, Tarddiad and Mazcab are explicit unresolved external destinations
coverage.regional_support_items: The ancient elven ritual shard's no-trading source route is mapped to Kandarin through the Lost Grove/Solak supply chain, with current effect and drop-rate metadata but no live GE price
coverage.regional_skilling: region-defining training activities, production infrastructure, reward shops, gameplay-obtainable XP outfits, skilling off-hands and late-game tool chains are now indexed separately from raw XP methods; Prifddinas, flask infrastructure, Deep Sea Fishing, Archaeology Guild upgrades, Garden of Kharid, Lava Flow Mine, Woodcutter's Grove, Croesus/Gate off-hands and cross-region tool chains are included
coverage.quests: current RuneScape Wiki quest-list entries are revision-pinned, grouped by primary and recursively required regions, with official Equilibrium auto-completion kept as a separate Jagex-only overlay
coverage.permanent_unlocks: base spell/prayer books, quest abilities, modern Shattered Worlds/Mazcab/Tuska acquisition, Livid Farm's 2026 point ladder, Well of Souls, War's Retreat, Anachronia/account passives, regional achievement passives, Ring of Vigour, Salve (e), Holy wrench, attuned ectoplasmator, advanced gold accumulator, Seedicide, Spring cleaner, Mage Arena, Dreadnips, Asylum surgeon's ring, enchantments, flasks, high-value combat consumables, post-remaster Dungeoneering rewards/systems and post-aura replacement passives/Aspects are composed from base + current-audit + enrichment overlays; Equilibrium overrides remain separate
coverage.prayers: 46 Standard prayers, 45 Ancient Curses and the seven-prayer Seren subset now carry current effects, unlock profiles, source references and normal-game required regions; only Standard and Ancient Curses are switchable books
coverage.spellbooks: Standard, Ancient Magicks and Lunar are standalone planner data; Necromancy incantations and Daemonheim remain scoped special systems
coverage.masterwork_staff: tier-100 self-source chain mapped with explicit hard/conditional region pressure, current Abyssal synapse hotfix state, 2026 Havenhythe eternal-tree alternate location and weaker confidence retained where the complete flattened recipe is only cross-checked
coverage.training: all 29 named RS3 skills surface in the browser; combat-method candidates from PvME pages carrying the March 2026 site-wide stale warning are retained only as candidates and are no longer treated as current validation; no stale combat XP tables are promoted
coverage.slayer: 29 deduplicated high-value, collection-log and boundary-sensitive Slayer routes are preserved with alternate regions and source freshness visible; legacy PvME KPH/XP values remain guide context rather than optimizer-grade post-2026 rankings
coverage.runecrafting: altar geography plus 110 Runecrafting progression mapped, including Time altar, expansive pouch, eternal-magic weapon imbuing and the detailed Masterwork staff cross-region chain; optimizer-grade post-2026 XP benchmarks remain pending
coverage.invention: unlock ladder, item-level milestones, Ancient Invention and Scavenging are joined by all 69 active perks, current rare-material taxonomy coverage, 20 current weapon/armour perk families, utility bridge recipes, the Spring cleaner tight-spring bottleneck and explicit account/non-region material bottlenecks for self-sufficient planning; all 15 perks removed on 20 July 2026 are excluded
coverage.archaeology: qualification gates, dig-site unlocks, Ancient Invention, relic milestones, collection/repeatable routes and the authoritative Guild progression are composed with non-Guild duplicate mitigation, journal tracking/routing, museum overflow rules, monolith energy constraints and relic acquisition-region dependencies; uncertain League boundaries stay explicit
coverage.boss_specific_guides: intentionally excluded; unique rewards and progression dependencies may be indexed without copying boss strategies
